dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow got a deliberate trigger decision, but the required `unit-tests` check was handled with exactly the disqualified two-workflow same-check-name pattern (plus a workflow-level path filter on tests.yml), which the rubric caps at 4 and which lets a trivial skip-pass mask a real failure on mixed changesets.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's path list closely matches the files its own steps consume (deploy's src/package/deploy.sh, docs-site's docs/mkdocs, tests' src/test/package), plus the workflow file itself, rather than a catch-all or a copied sibling list.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: It correctly left the schedule-only and issue-driven workflows and the branch-protection ruleset untouched, but it introduced a new tests-skip.yml file the audit did not call for as a flawed workaround for the required check.
